review: Development-reviewed against M9-r6 failure shapes; not independent validation.
source_note: M10 BRIEF and read-only union-capture sentence shapes. No employer sector or level is inferred.

rows.pattern: ^(?:company\s*:|headquartered\b|(?:\w[\w .,&’'-]{0,80})\bis headquartered\b|through our\b.*\bbrands\b|our\s+[\d,]+\+?\s+employees\b|our (?:mission|goal|vision|values|company|brands|offices)\b)
rows.rationale: Employer identity, history and footprint, not an applicant capability.

rows.pattern: ^(?:we (?:are (?!looking|seeking|hiring)|have (?:been|over|more than)|offer|believe|serve|strive|foster)|join (?:us|our team)|for (?:more than|over) \d+ years|(?:our|the) company (?:is|has|offers))\b
rows.rationale: Company narrative; looking/seeking/hiring constructions are not swept in.

rows.pattern: ^(?:at\s+)?{employer}(?:\s+(?:group|inc\.?|corporation))?\s*(?:,?\s*(?:we(?:'re|’re| are)|is (?:a|an|one|the)|has (?:more|over)|offers|provides|was founded|is headquartered))\b
rows.rationale: Reviewed roster identity is only a template for detecting company prose, never sector inference.

rows.pattern: ^(?:apply today\b|learn more about (?:us|our company)|follow us on\b|discover how you can have a career|you(?:'ll|’ll) help accelerate {employer}(?:'s|’s) growth|our promise\b|about (?:us|our company)\b)
rows.rationale: Recruiting/company marketing does not establish a skill.

rows.pattern: ^(?:unless actual salary\b|(?:the )?(?:actual (?:salary|pay)|base (?:salary|pay)|salary range|pay range|compensation (?:range|overview)|the (?:minimum|maximum|annualized|expected).*(?:salary|pay))\b)
rows.rationale: Pay ranges and disclaimers, not HR compensation work.

rows.pattern: ^(?:this (?:role|position|job) is (?:also )?eligible.*(?:bonus|equity|incentive)|(?:the )?(?:annual|base) salary\b|(?:additionally,? )?(?:employees|you) (?:are|may be) eligible.*(?:bonus|equity|incentive)|(?:for|in) (?:ny|ca|us|united states).*\b(?:salary|base pay)\b)
rows.rationale: Employee remuneration and eligibility language.

rows.pattern: ^(?:(?:all )?benefits (?:are|include|will|vary)|(?:health|dental|vision|life|disability) insurance (?:is|coverage|benefits)|(?:our|the|a comprehensive) benefits (?:package|program|plan)|(?:we|{employer}) offer.*\b(?:benefits package|paid time off|retirement plan)|(?:please|to) (?:review|learn|read).*benefits|employees.*(?:eligible family|paid time off))\b
rows.rationale: Plan terms and benefit marketing; managing benefits is a real duty and survives.

rows.pattern: ^(?:(?:we|{employer}(?: group)?|the company) (?:are|is) (?:an? )?equal|(?:we|{employer}(?: group)?) (?:do(?:es)? not|will not) discriminate|equal (?:employment )?opportunity\b|(?:all )?qualified applicants (?:will|are)|(?:we|{employer}).*\b(?:committed|providing)\b.*reasonable accommodations?\b.*applicant)
rows.rationale: Employer EEO/access policy, not knowledge of EEO rules or doing accommodation casework.

rows.pattern: ^(?:(?:if you|applicants|candidates|this position|employment|offers? of employment).*\b(?:background checks?|drug screen|accommodations?|criminal history|work authorization|authorized to work|visa|sponsorship)\b|(?:visa sponsorship|work authorization|background checks?|reasonable accommodations?)\b|{employer}.*\b(?:sponsor|visa|work authorization|criminal|background checks?)\b)
rows.rationale: Application eligibility and hiring legal notices.

rows.pattern: ^(?:(?:may |will |shall )?(?:perform |undertake |carry out )?(?:other|additional) duties(?: and responsibilities)?(?: as assigned| as required| may be assigned)|this (?:list|description) is not exhaustive|(?:the )?(?:above|this) (?:list|description).*(?:not exhaustive|not intended)|(?:your )?(?:job )?duties and responsibilities may change)
rows.rationale: Catch-alls and non-exhaustive-list disclaimers.

rows.pattern: ^(?:(?:company|location|job category|job title|job type|employment type|scheduled weekly hours|time type|department|primary location)\s*:|(?:responsibilities|key responsibilities|qualifications|basic qualifications|preferred qualifications|requirements|about you|about the role|job description|benefits|compensation)\s*:?\s*$)
rows.rationale: Heading echoes and label lines are not skill nodes.

rows.pattern: ^(?:not (?:recorded|applicable)|n/?a|a|or|and|equivalent|certification|degree|years|of|or equivalent(?: combination of (?:education|experience) and relevant work experience)?|a combination|experience|preferred|required|other duties|#\w+)\s*[.!:;]?$
rows.rationale: Residual label fragments, not a capability.

rows.pattern: ^{employer}\s*[.!:;]?$
rows.rationale: A stranded company name immediately before its pay-transparency heading only.
A standalone remuneration amount is not a skill.

rows.pattern: ^(?:WA|CA|NY|TX|US|USA)$
rows.rationale: Standalone location codes are label debris, not capabilities.

rows.pattern: ^(?:to support you.*guidance.*hiring process|we encourage candidates.*(?:during|interview|hiring)|please note.*(?:artificial intelligence|hiring|sponsorship)|please (?:review|read).*(?:benefits|remote work policy|flex.first)|(?:for us based candidates|this role is remote).*base pay|additionally.*new hire equity)\b
rows.rationale: Candidate-process guidance and stand-alone remuneration notices, not employee duties.
Punctuation-only remainders of split qualifications cannot name a skill.

rows.pattern: ^(?:by fostering a culture.*we deliver for|built on a .*foundation.*{employer}|our employees work in the office|(?:our|the) (?:headquarters|headcount|global offices)\b)
rows.rationale: Employer culture, footprint and work-arrangement narrative; an imperative HR culture duty is not matched.

rows.pattern: ^should the (?:level|location).*hiring process.*base pay range\b
rows.rationale: A range-update disclaimer is not capability evidence.

rows.pattern: ^(?:the position will be posted until|(?:this|the) (?:position|requisition) (?:will remain|is) open until)\b
rows.rationale: Requisition availability, not an applicant skill.

rows.pattern: ^(?:location (?:we|the|you|this)\b|(?:ability to )?travel,? occasionally overnight.*preferred qualifications|the requirements listed below.*representative|following is a summary of the essential functions)
rows.rationale: Flattened location/travel labels and list-introduction echoes, not HR policy work.

rows.pattern: ^(?:or )?equivalent (?:combination of )?(?:education|experience).*$
rows.rationale: A residual degree-equivalence clause belongs to qualification metadata, not a skill.

rows.pattern: ^(?:(?:strong|demonstrated|relevant|prior|previous|proven)\s+)?experience\s*[\W_]*$
rows.rationale: An experience prefix left by a years split has no domain and cannot be a skill.

rows.pattern: ^(?:some roles may require additional in-office|flexible to work across multiple time zones|learn more about life at|the (?:role|position) (?:is based|is located|requires residence))\b
rows.rationale: Office/location logistics and recruiting links are not skills; planning workforce locations remains a duty.

qualification.domain_suffix: (?:\s+(?:or equivalent education and related training|or related field, or equivalent education and related training)\s*\d*|[\s,;:/–—-]+|(?<!\w)(?:or|and|a combination|preferred|required)|\s+\d{1,2})+$
